definition: to lay or keep at a relatively lower place; to bring down.
example_en: He lowered the pot into the well and drew water.

definition: the traditional literary style.
example_en: This text follows the old traditional literary style.

definition: a smell of stale oil; a rancid smell.
example_en: A rancid smell was coming from the stale oil.

definition: any action, task, etc. undertaken or to be done; work.
example_en: There is a lot of work at home today.

definition: the time of the day when night ends or begins.
example_en: The sky turns red at the twilight hour.

definition: the new growth in a germinated seed, which would develop into a new plant; a sprout.
example_en: A new sprout had emerged from the sown seed.

definition: ground on which a building stands, stood or to stand; a site.
example_en: They bought a site for the new building.

definition: an assertion, statement, brief synopsis made at the beginning of an argument, that is to be proved as correct by oneself or as incorrect by another.
example_en: The scholars first presented the introductory assertion.

definition: that which is born along the shore, bank (of a river etc.) (as a tree).
example: ನದಿಯ ದಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಳೆದ ತಟಜ ಮರ ನೆರಳು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The tree born along the riverbank gives shade.

definition: unpleasantness; mental irritation.
example_en: Constant noise caused irritation.

definition: a shaft with a sharp point at one end.
example_en: The guard carried the pointed shaft on his shoulder.

definition: to regard with scorn; view or treat with contempt; to scorn; to look down.
example_en: He scorned the advice of the poor.

definition: a piece of grass land, exclusively kept for grazing cattle; a meadow.
example_en: They took the sheep to the meadow for grazing.

definition: any of the holy hymns.
example_en: The priests chanted the holy hymn.

definition: one whose profession is to print books, newspapers or pictures on cloth; a printer.
example: ಆ ಅಚ್ಚಾಳು ಪುಸ್ತಕಗಳನ್ನು ಬಹಳ ಶ್ರದ್ಧೆಯಿಂದ ಮುದ್ರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: That printer prints books with great care.

definition: something that is presented; a presentation; a gift.
example_en: The king honored the poet by giving him a gift.

definition: to desire, crave for something greedily.
example_en: The poor child craved greedily for the sweet snack.

definition: refused; rejected.
example_en: His application was rejected by the committee.

definition: a smith who works in iron; a blacksmith.
example_en: The blacksmith of that village sharpened the sword.

definition: to determine the weight of an object using a balance; to weigh.
example_en: The shopkeeper weighed the rice on the balance.

definition: a step put backward.
example_en: Seeing the snake, she took a step backward.

definition: the upper portion of the flank.
example_en: The pain from the wound appeared in the upper flank.

definition: (bubbles) to form.
example_en: Bubbles were forming in the boiling water.

definition: concentrated; focussed .
example_en: His attention was completely concentrated.

definition: a higher level.
example_en: He got a higher-level post in the office.

definition: a barbeṛs cutting or shaving instrument; a razor.
example_en: The barber sharpened his razor.

definition: to bestow kingship on.
example_en: God bestowed kingship on that young man.

definition: the bone of the cuttle-fish (that floats on the sea-water).
example_en: The cuttle-fish bone floats on the sea water.

definition: a kind of tree.
example_en: A gavade tree stood on the river bank.

definition: an apparatus to cut down the standing grass and level the lawn.
example: ತೋಟಗಾರ ಕುರುಪೆಯಿಂದ ಹುಲ್ಲನ್ನು ಕತ್ತರಿಸಿ ಹಸಿರುಹಾಸಿಗೆ ಸಮತಟ್ಟು ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: The gardener cut the grass with the lawn mower and levelled the green lawn.

definition: name of a country.
example_en: Sages came from the country Mala.

definition: a kind of medicinal plant.
example_en: The adikilu plant is used as a medicine for fever.

definition: to cause (a solid) to become liquid; to melt; to liquefy.
example_en: The ice melted in the sun and became water.

definition: a man, deity etc. who moves in the space; chiefly, a demigod.
example_en: The story of sky-moving demigods appears in the epic.

definition: to fill in, drive in forcefully.
example_en: He drove the nail forcefully into the wall.

definition: not moving, steady; fixed; firm.
example: ಆ ಬಂಡೆ ಎಷ್ಟೇ ಗಾಳಿ ಬೀಸಿದರೂ ಅವಿಚಲವಾಗಿ ನಿಂತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: That rock stood firm and unmoving however hard the wind blew.

definition: the ninth month in the Muslim calendar, a period of fasting from the sunrise to sunset.
example: ರಂಜಾನು ತಿಂಗಳಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಜನರು ಸೂರ್ಯೋದಯದಿಂದ ಸೂರ್ಯಾಸ್ತದವರೆಗೆ ಉಪವಾಸ ಇರುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: During the month of Ramzan, people fast from sunrise to sunset.

definition: a metal (esp. of copper) plate used to write a king's order or gift deed, etc. on.
example_en: The king's order was written on the metal plate.

definition: to rule, administrate the affairs of, a town.
example_en: That headman administered the town for many years.

definition: amorousness of a prostitute.
example_en: Her prostitute's amorousness became the subject of people's criticism.

definition: to cause to run across.
example_en: The player made the ball run across to the other side of the field.

definition: cattle excrement; dung; manure.
example_en: The farmer applied cattle dung to the field.

definition: a paved surface, as of concrete, brick, etc.;; pavement.
example_en: They had pavement laid in front of the house.

definition: a chief provincial governor.
example_en: The chief provincial governor administered that province.

definition: to play, amuse with.
example_en: The children played and amused themselves joyfully in the garden.

definition: the quality of being soft, pliable, flexible; softness; pliability; suppleness.
example_en: The softness of the cotton increases its value.

definition: a kind of medicinal herb.
example_en: The kalukaraka plant grows in the forest.

definition: the worldly life.
example_en: He renounced worldly life and became an ascetic.

definition: a ship driven by steam power; a steamship.
example_en: A large steamship was anchored at the harbor.

definition: an apparent bow; a rainbow.
example_en: A rainbow appeared in the sky after the rain.

definition: resembling; similar; looking alike.
example: ಆ ವಿಗ್ರಹದ ಮುಖ ಅವನ ತಂದೆಯ ಮುಖಕ್ಕೆ ಸನ್ನಿಭವಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The idol's face resembled his father's face.

definition: a man who lost the emancipated status of the soul.
example_en: He became a man who lost his emancipated status through sinful acts.

definition: a water tank, pond etc.
example_en: There was a big water tank outside the village.

definition: a small fixed wheel, sometimes turning in a block, with a grooved rim in which a rope or chain runs, as to raise a weight attached at one end by pulling on the other end; a pulley.
example_en: That pulley made a sound while turning.

definition: to have a defect; to become defective.
example_en: That machine became defective.

definition: the condition of being plural or numerous; plurality.
example_en: A plurality of religions is seen in this society.

definition: a sub-sect among Harijans.
example: ಆ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕಲ್ಲಾಳ ಸಮುದಾಯದವರು ಹೆಚ್ಚಾಗಿ ವಾಸಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: People of the Kallala community mostly live in that town.

definition: smooth and cajoling words (to inducing, persuading, etc.).
example_en: Charmed by his cajoling words, she agreed.

definition: a material or materials needed commonly by common people, as grains, other food items, etc. sold in a store; goods 2.the seed of food-plants; grain.
example_en: All the needed grocery goods are available at the shop.

definition: to cause to walk on, press or beat (something) with the feet.
example_en: The farmer made the buffalo tread and press the field.

definition: to make new or as if new again; to renew.
example: ಅವನು ಹಳೆಯ ಸ್ನೇಹವನ್ನು ಮತ್ತೆ ಹೊಸಗೆಯ್ಯಲು ಬಯಸಿದನು.
example_en: He wished to renew the old friendship again.

definition: the state or fact of being an owner; ownership.
example_en: The ownership of this house belongs to their family.

definition: the poker, shovel, and tongs used for tending a fireplace; a fire-irons.
example_en: Grandmother placed the fire-irons near the stove.

definition: any of the storeys above the ground floor; upstairs.
example_en: The whole village can be seen from the upstairs floor.

definition: temptation for or a being tempted by, a bribe.
example_en: They tempted the officer with a bribe and got the work done.

definition: the diffracted image of an object.
example_en: The diffracted image seen in the water was strange.

definition: any of the fevers that last for short period.
example: ಮಗುವಿಗೆ ತರುಣಜ್ವರ ಬಂದು ಎರಡು ದಿನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ವಾಸಿಯಾಯಿತು.
example_en: The child had a short-lived fever and recovered in two days.

definition: to be lessened in quantity, size, intensity, degree, etc.
example_en: As the wind blows, the flame of the fire diminishes.

definition: a current or flow of water.
example_en: The current of the river flows fast during the rainy season.

definition: a shaft with a pointed end used as a weapon for thrusting.
example_en: The warrior hurled the pointed shaft at the enemy.

definition: a person who defrauds, deceives or tricks others; a swindler ; a cheat.
example_en: The swindler earned money by deceiving people.

definition: the white-flowered, evergreen plant Thea sinensis (= Camelia thea, = C. sinensis) of Theaceae family; tea plant.
example_en: Farmers grow tea plants in the garden.

definition: she who speaks with involuntary pauses or blocks, often with rapid repetitions of first syllables or initial sounds; a stammerer.
example_en: That girl was a stammerer and struggled to speak.

definition: the act of rubbing (using some polishing substance) to make glossy; a polishing.
example_en: They polished the chair and made it glossy.

definition: (the greeness) to diminish; to become less greener.
example_en: Without rain the crop lost its greenness.

definition: absence of enmity, hatred, etc.
example_en: In that village, everyone lived without enmity.

definition: a heap of things swept up, as dirt, particles, etc. swept from a floor; sweepings.
example_en: A heap of sweepings lay in front of the house.

definition: the eye of a cow.
example_en: The priest explained the significance of worshipping the cow's eye.

definition: the area or region around or near some place or thing; vicinity; neighbourhood.
example_en: There are green trees around the vicinity of our house.

definition: (musical instrument) to make series of sounds.
example_en: The drum was resounding loudly.

definition: perfect accomplishment in an undertaking; success.
example_en: His efforts finally achieved success.

definition: unwise advice; ill-advice.
example: ಆ ಮಂತ್ರಿಯ ಕುಮಂತ್ರ ರಾಜ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಕೇಡು ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: That minister's bad advice brought harm to the kingdom.

definition: an unfriendly man; a man who is not liked.
example: ಆ ಅಪ್ರಿಯನ ಜೊತೆ ಯಾರೂ ಮಾತನಾಡಲು ಬಯಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: No one wishes to talk with that unfriendly man.

definition: a passing through a narrow passage or entrance.
example_en: He squeezed with difficulty through the narrow passage.

definition: a kind of plant( = hāvumekke ?).
example_en: They have grown the hārumekke plant in the garden.

definition: logical wisdom or acumen.
example_en: That scholar's logical wisdom astonished everyone.

definition: the highest point; peak; vertex.
example_en: The mountain peak was covered with clouds.

definition: to sing.
example: ಆ ಬಾಲಕ ವೇದಿಕೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಸುಂದರವಾಗಿ ಗಾಣತಿಗೆಯ್ದನು.
example_en: That boy sang beautifully on the stage.

definition: to kill; to cause to die.
example_en: That cruel man did not hesitate to kill the animal.

definition: the king of mountains.
example_en: The Himalayas are called the king of mountains.

definition: to press (the lips) together and part them suddenly so as to make a smack; to smack.
example_en: The baby smacks its lips and laughs.

definition: the sun, as a friend of lotus flowers.
example_en: When the sun rose, the lotuses bloomed.

definition: to submit (to someone or for some cause); to dedicate.
example_en: He dedicated his very life to the service of the nation.

definition: to praise highly; to eulogise; to laud; to extol.
example_en: People praised that achiever highly.

definition: any stratagem or ambush designed to kill; a trap to murder.
example_en: The thieves set a murder trap for him.

definition: to walk; to move on one's feet.
example: ಆಯಾಸಗೊಂಡ ಅವನು ಗೋಡೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಕೆಂದು ನಿಂತನು.
example_en: Tired, he stood leaning against the wall.

definition: a request for the transference of a case to a higher court or authority for rehearing or review the decision of a lower court or authority; an appeal.
example_en: He filed an appeal against the judgment.

definition: garments for the body; articles of dress; wearing apparel.
example_en: She prepared various garments for the wedding.

definition: the lowest portion; the bottom part.
example_en: There was a village at the bottom part of the hill.

definition: the plant Pisum sativum of Papilionaceae family.
example_en: The farmer sowed peas in the field.

definition: great fear causing bewilderment; consternation.
example: ಗುಡುಗಿನ ಶಬ್ದಕ್ಕೆ ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಜನರಿಗೆ ಸಾಧ್ವಸ ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: The sound of thunder caused great consternation among the village people.

definition: a hut or cottage of hermits or saints (being mostly made of leaves and grass).
example_en: The hermit performed penance in the forest hut.

definition: the hollow under the arm at the shoulder; the armpit; axilla.
example_en: His armpit was wet with sweat.

definition: a small bag to keep arecanut and beetle leaves.
example: ಅಜ್ಜಿಯ ಹಡಪದಲ್ಲಿ ಸದಾ ಅಡಿಕೆ ಎಲೆ ಇರುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: Grandmother's small bag always had areca nuts and betel leaves in it.

definition: a pit dug for bury a dead body.
example_en: The villagers dug a burial pit at the cremation ground.

definition: the tree Madhuca malabarica ( = Bassia malabarica) of Sapotaceae family.
example: ಹುಳಿನಾಣಲು ಮರದ ಕೆಳಗೆ ನಿಂತು ವಿಶ್ರಾಂತಿ ಪಡೆದರು.
example_en: They stood under the Madhuca malabarica tree and rested.

definition: a big building having two or more storeys, one above the other; a multi-storied building; a mansion.
example: ರಾಜನು ನದಿಯ ದಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಭವ್ಯ ಪ್ರಾಸಾದವನ್ನು ಕಟ್ಟಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The king built a grand mansion on the riverbank.

definition: that which is worn out or abraded (as by long use).
example: ಆ ಸಮಕಲು ಚಪ್ಪಲಿಯನ್ನು ಬಿಸಾಡು ಹೊಸದನ್ನು ತೆಗೆದುಕೊ.
example_en: Throw away that worn-out sandal and buy a new one.

definition: a mixed feeling of bewilderment and wonder.
example: ಆ ಅದ್ಭುತ ದೃಶ್ಯ ನೋಡಿ ಅವಳಿಗೆ ಬೆಳ್ಳಚ್ಚರಿ ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Seeing that wonderful sight, she was filled with a mix of bewilderment and wonder.

definition: a courageous and strong man.
example: ಆ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಿಂಡ ಎಂದೇ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಅವನನ್ನು ಕರೆಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: Everyone in that village called him a strong and courageous man.

definition: wind blowing unobsructed on the plains of an open region.
example_en: It felt pleasant when the open plain's wind struck the face.

definition: one who annoys, molests another or others; an annoyer.
example: ಆ ಕಾಡಿಗ ಊರಿನ ಜನರನ್ನು ಸದಾ ಕಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದ.
example_en: That annoyer always troubled the people of the village.

definition: to drive out or away; to chase away.
example_en: The watchman chased the dog away from the house.

definition: the natural expulsion of an embryo or foetus from the womb before it is sufficiently developed; abortion; miscarriage.
example_en: The doctor explained the miscarriage to her.

definition: absence of absolute confidence.
example_en: One can see a lack of absolute confidence in his words.

definition: a land gifted to a person, exempting fifty per cent of the normal tax on it.
example_en: That half-tax-exempt land had come down from his ancestors.

definition: a royal ornament.
example_en: The queen wore royal ornaments when she came to the assembly.

definition: a woman of that character, manner, etc.
example_en: Nobody trusts a woman of that character.

definition: (arrangement order, operation of something, etc.) to get upset; to be disaranged.
example_en: In the haste, all the plans got disarranged.

definition: associated, mingled or blended well.
example_en: The thoughts of the two people blended well and became one.

definition: a note in explanation, criticism or illustration of something written or said; annotation.
example_en: He wrote an annotation beside the lesson.

definition: the state or period of being a boy or girl; boyhood or girlhood.
example: ಚಿಕ್ಕತನದಲ್ಲಿ ನಾವು ಈ ಮರದ ಕೆಳಗೆ ಆಟವಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದೆವು.
example_en: In our boyhood, we used to play under this tree.

definition: the quality or condition of being straight.
example_en: The straightness of this line is very good.

definition: a protective place for ships; a ship-harbour.
example_en: When the storm came, the ships came to the harbour.

definition: the vow by a widow of not remarrying and devoting her life for religious purpose.
example: ಆಕೆ ಪತಿಯ ಮರಣದ ನಂತರ ವಿಶ್ವಸ್ತವ್ರತವನ್ನು ಕೈಗೊಂಡಳು.
example_en: After her husband's death, she took the vow of a widow's devotion.

definition: a practice or custom that is based on a belief that is inconsistent with the known laws of science or with what is gen. considered in a particular society as true and rational, such as belief in charms, omens, the supernatural, etc. (due chiefly to fear or ignorance); superstition.
example_en: Many superstitious practices are still followed in the village.

definition: the front portion of the head.
example_en: The grandmother stroked the front of the child's head.

definition: to become a soft, semisolid mass; to become coagulated, curds.
example: ಬಿಸಿ ಹಾಲಿಗೆ ನಿಂಬೆ ಹಾಕಿದಾಗ ಅದು ಹೆರುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: When lemon is added to hot milk, it coagulates.

definition: the act of searching; a looking for.
example_en: The search for truth never stops.

definition: to cause to kill, slay or murder.
example_en: His own hatred caused him to be killed.

definition: an excellent brāhmaṇa.
example_en: The excellent brahmana had the worship performed in the temple.

definition: a bridge-like system that conveys people and goods from one place to another.
example_en: This conveying bridge connects two towns.

definition: widely but unfavourably known or talked about; notorious.
example_en: That thief was notorious throughout the district.

definition: a worn out coin.
example_en: The shopkeeper rejected the worn-out coin.

definition: to spoil the natural form, beauty; to deform.
example_en: The hot water deformed the shape of the cloth.

definition: that which is bad or morally or socially unacceptable.
example: ಸುಳ್ಳು ಹೇಳುವುದು ಹೊಲ್ಲ ಗುಣ ಎಂದು ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಒಪ್ಪುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: Everyone agrees that lying is a socially unacceptable trait.

definition: freedom from destruction; imperishableness.
example_en: The scriptures teach the imperishableness of the soul.

definition: a series of mistakes happened or committed.
example_en: A series of mistakes had occurred in his accounts.

definition: a lessee who has got a property under lease from another person who is the first lessee of the property; a sub-lessee.
example_en: That shop was sub-leased to the sub-lessee.

definition: the quality or disposition of receiving and treating guests and strangers in a warm, friendly, generous way; an instance of this.
example_en: All the guests liked his hospitality.

definition: the area or extent to which something has grown or covered by something.
example: ಬೆಳೆಯ ಮಡಿಲು ಈ ಬಾರಿ ಬಹಳ ವಿಸ್ತಾರವಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: The extent covered by the crop is very wide this time.

definition: the act of painting, adding colour or colours, etc.
example_en: The artist gave beautiful coloring to the painting.

definition: to bear pain, etc. without flinching; to endure; to be patient.
example: ಅವನು ನೋವನ್ನು ಸೈರಿಸಿ ಒಂದು ಮಾತನ್ನೂ ಆಡಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: He endured the pain and did not say a single word.

definition: a man belonging to kṣatriya (military) caste.
example_en: That kṣatriya man displayed valour in the war.

definition: the complete structure; the entire manner or method of building.
example_en: The complete structure of that house was very sturdy.

definition: discussion in which there is disagreement; dispute; debate; argument.
example_en: A dispute arose between the two of them.

definition: an eye that has become red with fury.
example_en: His fury-reddened eye turned even redder with anger.

definition: transparent, colourless or slightly tinged quartz; a crystal.
example: ಆ ಪಟಿಕೆಯ ಹರಳು ಬೆಳಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಫಳಫಳ ಹೊಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: That crystal stone glittered brightly in the light.

definition: to pulverise completely.
example_en: He pulverised the stone completely with the grinding stone.

definition: to create a literary or musical work.
example: ಆ ಕವಿ ಪ್ರಕೃತಿಯ ಸೌಂದರ್ಯವನ್ನು ಸಂದರ್ಭಿಸಿ ಕಾವ್ಯ ಬರೆದನು.
example_en: That poet created a literary work depicting the beauty of nature.

definition: the state of being full; fullness; completeness.
example_en: It is self-knowledge that brings fullness to life.

definition: red granite stone.
example_en: The temple's steps were made of red granite stone.

definition: the food served for eating or eaten.
example_en: They prepared the food in the evening and called everyone to eat.

definition: to become united; to mingle or mix with others as to become a homogenous whole.
example: ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಜನ ಒಗ್ಗೂಡಿ ಒಂದಾಗಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: All the people united and worked together as one.

definition: a cavalry having around one hundred horsemen.
example_en: The cavalry unit set out towards the border.

definition: painful or resentful awareness of an advantage enjoyed by another joined with a desire to possess the same advantage; envy.
example: ಅವನ ಯಶಸ್ಸು ಕಂಡು ಅವಳಿಗೆ ಕೀಣ ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Seeing his success, envy arose in her.

definition: a village servant.
example: ಕುಲವಾಡಿ ಊರಿನ ಎಲ್ಲ ಸಮಾಚಾರವನ್ನು ಪಟೇಲರಿಗೆ ತಿಳಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The village servant informed the headman of all the village news.

definition: excessive lenience.
example_en: The workers became lazy because of the officials' excessive leniency.

definition: (vīr.) a devotee who has renounced his or her worldly attachments.
example: ತ್ಯಾಗಾಂಗಿಯು ತನ್ನ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಲೌಕಿಕ ಬಂಧನಗಳನ್ನು ತೊರೆದನು.
example_en: The devotee who renounced worldly attachments gave up all his worldly bonds.

definition: any of several vegetable substances, as cloves, cinnamon, nutmeg or pepper, used to season food; a hot spice.
example_en: She mixed hot spice into the cooking.

definition: one who accomplishes the work undertaken.
example_en: He completed the work as one who accomplishes what he undertakes.

definition: the condition of prices of commodities being lower; sluggishness in market.
example: ಈ ವರ್ಷ ತರಕಾರಿ ಬೆಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮಂದಿ ಕಂಡುಬಂದಿದೆ.
example_en: This year there is sluggishness in vegetable prices.

definition: seized by wonder; filled with wonder.
example_en: He was filled with wonder on seeing that sight.

definition: any of several families of primates usu. having a flat, hairless face and a long tail; a monkey.
example_en: A monkey on the street stole a banana.

definition: a making merry, laughing, and having fun; conviviality; festivity; merry-making.
example_en: There was a lot of merry-making in the wedding house.

definition: any tolerable pain.
example_en: He bore the tolerable pain after the surgery.

definition: (leucoderma) to affect a person with white patches on the body.
example_en: That disease afflicted his skin with white patches.

definition: a wide cot (used to sleep on).
example_en: They laid out a wide cot for the guests.

definition: the form or shape of something.
example_en: The shape of this pot is very beautiful.

definition: butter clarified by boiling; ghee.
example_en: They used pure ghee for cooking.

definition: a screaming as from pain, fear, etc., 2) a rumbling, roaring sound.
example_en: The animal's roar was heard in the darkness.

definition: a brutal, uncivilised man; a ruffian.
example: ಊರಿನ ಜನರು ಆ ಅಡ್ಡನಾಡಿಯನ್ನು ಭಯದಿಂದ ದೂರವಿಟ್ಟರು.
example_en: The villagers kept away from that ruffian out of fear.

definition: a place full of rocks, boulders, stones, etc.
example_en: That rocky place is full of boulders.

definition: amounting to two thousand.
example_en: Two-thousand people had gathered for that assembly.

definition: an outer, upper garment, with or without sleeves, of women.
example_en: The queen wore a silk upper garment.

definition: a decorated pot worshipped in marriages.
example_en: They had decorated the ritual pot in the wedding hall.

definition: a person who drives an automobile.
example_en: The driver drove the bus carefully.

definition: to become strong or stronger.
example_en: The soldiers' courage grew strong from the teacher's words.

definition: to light a torch.
example_en: They lit a torch before the procession.

definition: a living together hormoniously without hostility.
example_en: The people of the town were living together harmoniously.

definition: the rising sun.
example_en: The rising sun shone brightly from over the hill.

definition: an offering of food, fruit, etc. to a deity.
example_en: Every day they offer nevedya at the temple.

definition: college or university education; higher education.
example_en: The government provides subsidy for higher education.

definition: (said of a god) he who is at the behest of his devotees.
example_en: That god is famed as one who submits to his devotees' wishes.

definition: a raised patch of skin, esp. of epidermis, filled with watery matter and caused by a burn, rubbing, etc.; a blister.
example: ಬೆಂಕಿ ತಾಗಿ ಅವನ ಕೈಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪುಗುಳು ಎದ್ದಿತು.
example_en: A blister rose on his hand from the burn.

definition: the act or habit of acting in a dictatorial, arrogant manner; overbearingness.
example_en: No one could tolerate his overbearing manner.

definition: a deriding or being derided; contempt or ridicule; derision.
example: ಅವನ ಱೋಡಗತನವನ್ನು ಕಂಡು ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಮುಖ ತಿರುಗಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: Seeing his contemptuous mockery, everyone turned their faces away.

definition: a man who restrains or has a tendency to restrain (others or his own passions).
example: ಆ ದಮನಶೀಲ ತನ್ನ ಸಿಟ್ಟನ್ನು ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ ಹಿಡಿತದಲ್ಲಿಟ್ಟುಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That restraining man always kept his anger under control.

definition: a man who lends money at a higher rate of interest.
example: ದ್ವೈಗುಣಿಕನಿಂದ ಸಾಲ ಪಡೆದರೆ ಬಡ್ಡಿ ಬಹಳ ಹೆಚ್ಚಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: If you borrow from a man who lends at a higher rate of interest, the interest becomes very high.

definition: the act of going, climbing or mounting up; a rise; soar.
example_en: The climb up the hill was steep and difficult.

definition: fast pace in keeping time in music.
example: ಹಾಡಿನ ಓಗವನ್ನು ಕೇಳಿ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಚಪ್ಪಾಳೆ ತಟ್ಟಿದರು.
example_en: Hearing the fast pace of the song, everyone clapped.

definition: the act of buying; a purchase.
example_en: The purchase of that house was very profitable.

definition: to see; to look at.
example_en: He looked at the picture.

definition: the work or art of a person who carves.
example_en: The carving work of that idol was wonderful.

definition: to compress; to make compact.
example_en: The workers compressed the soil and made it firm.

definition: the way, manner, disposition or process of or suited to philosophy.
example: ಆ ಸಂತನ ಮಾತುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಆಳವಾದ ತತ್ವದೃಷ್ಟಿ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: That saint's words carried a deep philosophical outlook.

definition: a swollen or bulged chin.
example_en: Due to fever, his chin was swollen.

definition: a narrow path.
example: ಗ್ರಾಮಸ್ಥರು ಆ ಕಿರುದಾರಿಯ ಮೂಲಕ ಗುಡ್ಡ ಹತ್ತಿದರು.
example_en: The villagers climbed the hill through that narrow path.

definition: an official document issued by a government to its citizen for travel abroad; a passport.
example_en: He could not go abroad without a passport.

definition: anxious concern in a person or a thing that belongs to others.
example: ಅವಳಿಗೆ ಇತರರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಸುಮ್ಮನೆ ಪರವಾ ಬೇಡ.
example_en: She need not have needless concern about others' affairs.

definition: to move (oneself) along a surface by rotation without sliding; to roll.
example_en: The ball rolled down from the hill.

definition: to move forward; to continue the journey.
example_en: The travellers moved forward towards the hill.

definition: ruthlessness; mercilessness; heartlessness.
example_en: Her heartlessness annoyed everyone.

definition: the ruling of a monarch, king or an elected assembly; reign.
example_en: That king's reign was pleasant for the people.

definition: to be associated, mixed (with); to join or be intertwined.
example_en: The two groups pushed and became intertwined together.

definition: the quality or state of being straight; straightness.
example_en: That pillar's straightness is very good.

definition: the perennial plant Acorus calamus of Araceae family with sword-shaped leaves.
example_en: The leaves of the kavana plant are sword-shaped.

definition: the physical or gross body (as diff. from the subtle body).
example_en: Leaving the gross body, the soul dwells in the subtle body.

definition: an ugly person.
example_en: The children got scared seeing that ugly person.

definition: with a heavy sound.
example_en: The wooden log fell to the ground with a heavy thud.

definition: compassion towards all the living beings.
example_en: That saint was filled with compassion for all living beings.

definition: the state of being deformed; the state of having lost a portion of the body; want of natural form; deformity.
example_en: He suffered bodily deformity due to the accident.

definition: to put down; to reduce in height, elevation, amount, price etc.
example_en: The shopkeeper reduced the price.

definition: (a failure, mistake) to happen.
example_en: A big mistake happened in the exam.

definition: a going about; a walking or wandering through.
example_en: That sage was wandering from village to village.

definition: the quality of being brave; bravery; strength that enables one to face danger undauntedly; boldness; daring; heroism.
example: ಆ ಯೋಧನ ಅಧಟು ಯುದ್ಧದಲ್ಲಿ ಎದ್ದು ಕಾಣುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: That warrior's bravery stood out in the battle.

definition: an elephant-killer.
example: ಆ ಬೇಟೆಗಾರ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಆನೆಗುಲಿ ಎಂದು ಹೆಸರಾಗಿದ್ದ.
example_en: That hunter was known in the village as an elephant-killer.

definition: the intention, purpose or aim of an action.
example_en: Everyone knows the purpose of this meeting.

definition: (pl.) two channels for the outflow of excess water from a tank.
example_en: The excess water flowed out through the tank's two outflow channels.

definition: to cause to become coagulated, solidified.
example_en: She caused the milk to coagulate into curd.

definition: a coronated man; a king.
example_en: That crowned king was popular among the subjects.

definition: with the characteristic sound as made by popping corn.
example_en: The corn popped with a characteristic popping sound.

definition: an area of one square mile.
example: ಆ ಪಟ್ಟಣ ಸುಮಾರು ಹತ್ತು ಚದರಮೈಲು ಇದೆ.
example_en: That town is about ten square miles in area.

definition: the parasitic insect Pediculus humanus capitis, that lives on the hair of humans; head louse.
example_en: Head lice were found in the child's hair.

definition: that which is not right, fair or is contrary to justice.
example_en: Snatching the money of the poor is an unjust act.

definition: a small, circular band of metal, plastic, etc.; a ring; a bangle.
example_en: The gold bangle on her hand was glittering.

definition: perfumed; giving out good smell.
example: ಆ ಅಗರಬತ್ತಿಯ ಕಷಾಯ ಸುವಾಸನೆ ಮನೆಯ ತುಂಬಾ ಹರಡಿತು.
example_en: The perfumed fragrance of that incense spread through the house.

definition: a condition in which the feces are dry and hardened and evacuation is difficult and infrequent; constipation.
example_en: The doctor gave medicine for the constipation.

definition: in a special manner; particularly; specially; especially.
example_en: He had come specially for this work.

definition: to become intricate, difficult or complicated.
example_en: The work became even more complicated.

definition: a sudden, sharp pain caused by involuntary contraction of a muscle or muscles from chill, strain, etc.; cramp.
example_en: After exercise, a cramp came in the leg.

definition: a length of a hollow pipe of glass, rubber or metal, for conveying fluids; a tube.
example: ಆ ಲೋಹದ ಲಳಗಿಯ ಮೂಲಕ ಎಣ್ಣೆ ಹರಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: They made the oil flow through that metal tube.

definition: the act of developing, increasing or growing.
example: ಈ ಯೋಜನೆ ರೈತರ ಆದಾಯದ ವರ್ಧನೆಗೆ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡಿತು.
example_en: This scheme helped in the growth of the farmers' income.

definition: a group of states or territories under the sovereign power of an emperor or empress; an empire.
example_en: That emperor's empire had spread very far.

definition: a variety among the plants of the Chrysanthemum genus of plants of Asteraceae family.
example_en: The water chrysanthemum flower bloomed in the lake.

definition: sharp, caustic remark.
example_en: Hearing his caustic remark, everyone fell silent.

definition: the art or work of ornamenting fabric with needlework.
example_en: Her embroidery work was very delicate.

definition: a temporary shelter made of canvas, usu. raised on poles; a tent.
example: ಪ್ರವಾಸಿಗರು ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ಮೇಲೆ ಪಟವಾಸ ಹಾಕಿ ಉಳಿದುಕೊಂಡರು.
example_en: The travelers pitched a tent on the hill and stayed there.

definition: the act or fact of encircling, surrounding.
example_en: The soldiers carried out the encircling of the fort.

definition: to become abundant, superfluous.
example_en: Vegetables became abundant at the market and the price fell.

definition: that part of a cart for people to sit or to keep luggage.
example_en: They placed the bags on the cart's seat.

definition: to cause mental or physical agitation to; to cause pain or discomfort; to harass; to perturb; to trouble.
example_en: That news caused distress to the whole family.

definition: moral baseness; wickedness; evilness.
example_en: His wickedness made him lose everyone's trust.

definition: a man who steals; a thief.
example_en: The thief broke into the house at night.

definition: in hand spinning, a rounded rod, usu. wooden, tapering toward each end, for twisting into thread the fibres pulled from the material on the distaff, and notched at one end so as to hold the thread; a spindle.
example_en: She spun thread with the help of the spindle.

definition: the act or fact of making late, slowing up; a delaying.
example_en: Out of laziness, he delayed the work.

definition: to make up one's mind or reach a decision, about; to determine; to decide.
example_en: He decided to leave the town.

definition: a man in charge of a department, institution, etc.; a supervisor; a superintendent.
example_en: That shop's supervisor is very honest.

definition: a cot with a corded bottom.
example: ಅಜ್ಜ ನುಲಿಮಂಚದ ಮೇಲೆ ಕುಳಿತು ಕಥೆ ಹೇಳಿದ.
example_en: Grandfather sat on the corded cot and told a story.

definition: a contradicting or being contradicted; contradiction.
example_en: A contradiction was found in his statement.

definition: a small package.
example_en: The shopkeeper packed the goods into a small package.

definition: that which is useless or worthless.
example_en: All the old goods lay useless.

definition: to shake oneself; to move on to either side; to quiver, quake, totter, vibrate, etc.
example_en: The leaves of the tree quivered in the wind.

definition: a butcher - a) a person whose trade it is to slaughter domestic animals for food; b) a person who sells the flesh of such animals; c) a person who delights in killing.
example: ಆ ಕಡಿಕ ಕುರಿಗಳನ್ನು ಕೊಯ್ದು ಮಾಂಸ ಮಾರುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That butcher used to slaughter sheep and sell the meat.

definition: a kind of raw salt.
example_en: The fishermen dried the fish after applying raw salt to it.

definition: a man who devises, plans or plots artfully with an evil intent; a cunning man; a plotter; a schemer.
example: ಆ ಕಣ್ಣೋಜಿ ಎಲ್ಲರನ್ನೂ ಮೋಸ ಮಾಡಲು ಸಂಚು ಹೂಡಿದನು.
example_en: That schemer plotted to deceive everyone.

definition: a barrier built to hold back flowing water; a dam.
example: ರೈತರು ಹೊಲಕ್ಕೆ ನೀರು ಹಿಡಿಯಲು ನೀರ್ಕಟ್ಟೆ ಕಟ್ಟಿದರು.
example_en: The farmers built a dam to hold water for the field.

definition: a kind of white ass.
example_en: In that village they rear white asses.

definition: the quality or fact of being excess, too much; excessiveness.
example: ಅವನ ಕೋಪದ ಘಾಡಿ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಆಶ್ಚರ್ಯ ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: The excessiveness of his anger surprised everyone.

definition: a single finger.
example_en: A single finger broke and it hurt a lot.

definition: a master; a lord; an employer.
example: ಆ ಮನೆಯ ಸಾಮಿ ಎಲ್ಲ ಕೆಲಸಗಾರರಿಗೂ ಸಂಬಳ ಕೊಟ್ಟನು.
example_en: The master of that house paid wages to all the workers.

definition: a man who spends possessions or money extravagantly or wastefully; prodigal; a spendthrift.
example_en: The spendthrift man spent everything he had earned.

definition: long, plaited hair.
example_en: Her long plaited hair hung down to her mid-back.

definition: to cause to pour (a liquid) freely down.
example_en: The grandmother had her granddaughter pour milk into the cup.

definition: to gain, assume, be charged with, power.
example: ಆ ಸೇನಾಪತಿ ಯುದ್ಧದಲ್ಲಿ ಗೆದ್ದು ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಅಧಿಕಾರ ಅದಟಾನಿದನು.
example_en: That general won the battle and assumed greater power.

definition: a slow walking by limping; limp.
example: ಗಾಯಗೊಂಡ ಕಾಲಿನಿಂದ ಅವನ ಕುಂಟುನಡೆ ಇನ್ನೂ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: His limp from the injured leg still continued.

definition: a big defeat that damages heavily.
example_en: He suffered a crushing defeat in the election.

definition: a whimsical man.
example: ಆ ಕಾಮಗಾಮಿ ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ಬೇರೆ ಬೇರೆ ಮಾತಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: That whimsical man talks differently every day.

definition: a person who has done his work.
example_en: Having finished all his work, he became a man who had accomplished his task.

definition: not reliable; not worthy of being trusted.
example_en: His words seemed unreliable.

definition: a barber's place of business; a barber shop.
example_en: The village's barber shop is next to the market.

definition: a kind of eye disease, characterised by a white opaque layer developing on the eye.
example_en: That child had developed the white opaque eye disease.

definition: an unlawful, illicit act.
example: ಅವರು ಬೇಕಾಯಿದೆಶೀರ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದಾರೆ ಎಂದು ಪೊಲೀಸರು ಹೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: The police said they had done an unlawful act.

definition: a smiling face.
example_en: That child's smiling face captivated everyone.

definition: a shaking vehemently.
example_en: The house shook from the storm's vehement shaking.

definition: a man of white or light brown complexion.
example: ಬೆಳುಕನಾದ ಅವನು ಬಿಸಿಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಬಿಳಿಯ ಛತ್ರಿ ಹಿಡಿದು ನಡೆದನು.
example_en: Being a man of fair complexion, he walked in the sun holding a white umbrella.

definition: (usu. in pl.) unconcerned, outside persons.
example_en: This matter is not related to unconcerned outsiders.

definition: a small book; esp. a compact reference book on some subject; manual of facts or instructions; a hand-book.
example_en: He has kept a handbook in his pocket.

definition: a man originally belonging to England or whose mother-tongue is English; an English-man.
example: ಆ ಇಂಗರೀಜ ಭಾರತದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಲವು ವರ್ಷ ಇದ್ದನು.
example_en: That Englishman lived in India for many years.

definition: a stroke with or as with the thunderbolt (of Indra, the Chief of gods).
example_en: The demon was destroyed by the stroke of Indra's thunderbolt.

definition: a portion or division of a garden or farm land.
example_en: Vegetables had been grown in that plot of the farm.

definition: a deathlessperson.
example_en: In the epics, the sages are called deathless beings.

definition: a small present of money given directly to someone for performing a service or menial task; a tip.
example_en: He gave a tip to the servant and left.

definition: to grind, pound into small pieces, particles or powder.
example_en: She ground the spice ingredients into small pieces on the stone.

definition: the state of being a woman; womanhood.
example_en: That story shows the strength of womanhood.

definition: without cost of payment; free.
example_en: Medicine is available for free at that hospital.

definition: a state in South India between Karnāṭaka and Bay of Bengal; Tamil Nadu.
example_en: They speak the Tamil language in Tamil Nadu.

definition: a fetter or shackle for the hands or feet.
example_en: In the prison, shackles were put on the prisoner's feet.

definition: that which or he who, is worshipped, served, religiously attended to.
example_en: In that temple the god is worshipped by devotees.

definition: to cut, severed.
example_en: The branch was cut by the stroke of the sword.

definition: waste matter expelled from the bowels; excrement; faeces.
example_en: They cleaned up the excrement that had fallen in the field.

definition: a form of social organisation in which the mother is head of the family, and in which descent is reckoned in the female line, the children belonging to the mother's clan; matriarchal system; matriarchy.
example: ಆ ಬುಡಕಟ್ಟಿನಲ್ಲಿ ತಾಯಾಳಿಕೆ ಪದ್ಧತಿ ಇಂದಿಗೂ ಇದೆ.
example_en: The matriarchal system still exists in that tribe.

definition: a loosened fist or grip.
example_en: The rope slipped away because of his loosened grip.

definition: a continuous, confusing sound.
example_en: The continuous, confusing noise of people in the market was deafening.

definition: the state, fact or an instance of obeying or a willingness to obey; submission; obedience.
example_en: The child showed obedience to its parents.

definition: a slippery way or path.
example_en: Walking on that slippery path in the rain is dangerous.

definition: that which is black or of black complexion.
example_en: That black-complexioned buffalo was grazing in the field.

definition: depending on another.
example: ಆ ಹುಡುಗ ಇತರರ ಸಹಾಯದ ಮೇಲೆ ಆಶ್ರಯಿ ಆಗಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That boy was dependent on others' help.

definition: one time; once.
example_en: He said that just once, as a single instance.

definition: agreement in feeling, action, ideas, interests, etc.; consonance; concordance; harmony.
example_en: There was good harmony between the two of them.

definition: a finger nail, that has grown long and is sharp.
example_en: He peeled the fruit's skin with his long sharp fingernail.

definition: a simple house having a roof made of leafy twigs, as the house of a hermit.
example_en: The sage was meditating in the leaf-roofed hut.

definition: to cease to exist; to die.
example_en: Many soldiers perished in the war.

definition: to press very hard as to reduce (something) to powder.
example_en: He pressed the stone hard until it turned to powder.

definition: a gambling game played with dice.
example_en: He lost a lot of money in the dice game.

definition: to play a musical instrument.
example_en: The child is learning to play the tabla.

definition: a moving by a quick springy leap or in a series of leaps; a hopping.
example_en: The children were engaged in joyful hopping.

definition: again and again; repeatedly.
example_en: He makes the same mistake again and again.

definition: an instrument used in preparing the warp.
example_en: The weaver prepared the yarn's warp with the instrument.

definition: the state or quality of being arrogant, overbearing or unduly domineering.
example: ಅಧಿಕಾರದ ಉನ್ಮದದಿಂದ ಅವನು ಎಲ್ಲರನ್ನೂ ತಾತ್ಸಾರ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: Out of the arrogance of power, he disregarded everyone.

definition: official records collectively.
example_en: They examined the old official records.

definition: an official in charge of maintaining public grasslands.
example_en: The grassland officer used to look after the village's public grassland.

definition: to light or kindle fire.
example_en: He kindled fire with dry wood.

definition: impossible to be tested, examined.
example_en: This matter is impossible to test and no one can know it.

definition: a female horse; a mare.
example_en: That mare was running very fast.

definition: wearing a coat of mail; armoured.
example_en: The armoured soldiers stood at the gate of the fort.

definition: fame; good reputation.
example_en: That poet gained fame everywhere.

definition: to engage in or wage a war.
example_en: The two kingdoms waged war over the border.

definition: any machine supported for flight in the air by buoyancy or by the dynamic action of air on its surfaces, esp. powered airplanes, gliders; an aircraft.
example_en: The aircraft was flying swiftly across the sky.

definition: one whose profession is to grind grains into flours.
example_en: The flour-grinder ground the wheat into flour.

definition: Śiva, the destroyer of Yama, the Death-God.
example_en: Devotees worship Kalahara as Shiva.

definition: a person in the army who fights riding on a horse, elephant, camel, chariot etc. (dif. from a foot-soldier).
example: ಆ ಮೇಲಾಳ್ ಕುದುರೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಕುಳಿತು ಯುದ್ಧ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: That cavalry soldier fought seated on his horse.

definition: renown; fame.
example_en: That king had great renown everywhere.

definition: the precious yellow metallic element, highly malleable and ductile, and not subject to oxidation or corrosion (symbol: Au); gold.
example_en: Gold was shining in the queen's crown.

definition: a winged-species of ants.
example_en: During the rainy season, winged ants were flying around the lamp.

definition: a joining, combining of different things together.
example_en: The combining of those clothes together looked nice.

definition: a union; a conjunction.
example: ಎರಡು ಪಕ್ಷಗಳ ಸಂಯುಗ ಚುನಾವಣೆಗೆ ಮುನ್ನ ನಡೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The union of the two parties happened before the election.

definition: (a compound, but used as a single word) 'is it not?'.
example_en: You are coming, is it not?

definition: a small tent.
example_en: The travellers stayed the night in a small tent.

definition: to affect the nervous system of, so as to cause a loss of control; to make drunk; to enebriate.
example_en: Excess liquor made him drunk.

definition: pretentiousness; pretension; ostentation.
example_en: People laughed seeing his pretentiousness.

definition: to burn ablaze.
example_en: The flame burned ablaze in the ritual fire-pit.

definition: of the home; domestic; homely.
example_en: She has more interest in domestic chores.

definition: a secret killing; a murder committed with a planned conspiracy.
example: ಆ ಕವೞ್ಗೊಲೆಯ ಸುದ್ದಿ ಇಡೀ ಊರನ್ನು ಬೆಚ್ಚಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The news of that secret murder shocked the whole village.

definition: to set upon or work against forcefully; to attack.
example_en: The soldiers attacked the enemy camp.

definition: a doubt, uncertainty, diffidence expressed.
example_en: Really! I have doubts whether this is true.

definition: a person to whom another's property or the management of another's property is entrusted; a trustee.
example_en: He was appointed as the trustee of that property.

definition: a dividing or being divided; separation.
example_en: The separation of property took place among the brothers.

definition: the plant Malva rotundifolia of Malvaceae family.
example_en: The Malva rotundifolia plant spreads and grows along the edge of the paddy field.

definition: the predetermined, inevitable event.
example: ಅವನ ಮರಣ ವಿಧಾತೃಕಲ್ಪಿತವಾಗಿತ್ತು ಎಂದು ಜನರು ನಂಬಿದರು.
example_en: People believed his death was a predetermined event.

definition: a warehouse; a godown.
example_en: The goods have been kept in the warehouse.
